The difference between yearly members and monthly members isn't the plan. It's the mindset they show up with.
 
Monthly members treat AI video like a trial. They post when they feel like it. They skip weeks when work gets busy. They watch a lesson but don't apply it. Every month, they check if they're getting enough out of it to keep paying.
 
Yearly members show up like they're already in. They don't treat lessons as optional. They post work every week. They ask questions in the community. They put in the reps that turn AI skills into paid clients.
 
The plan doesn't cause the difference. The mindset the plan creates does.
 
You can pick either. But you can't pick monthly and expect to show up like a yearly member. Almost no one does.
 
Inside AI Video Bootcamp, the yearly plan is $55. Less than a coffee a week. Locked in for the year so you show up like it matters.

✅ Weekly cash challenges with real prize money
✅ The Opportunity Hub where brands post paid work for members
✅ 1-to-1 feedback on your work
✅ 24,000+ creators sharing what actually works
✅ 7-day money-back guarantee
 
Members close their first paid deal in 3 weeks on average. One client covers the year 20 times over.
